name: Pension Fischbacher
beschreibung:
Overview

The Pension Fischbacher is located in the heart of Walchsee in the Kaiserwinkl in Tyrol, at Alleestraße 16. The house is run personally by Clara Fischbacher and operates as a bed-and-breakfast guesthouse, i.e. a private-rooms establishment with around 27 double rooms. The rooms are furnished in cosy Tyrolean style and feature cable TV, an en-suite bathroom with shower/WC, a hairdryer on request, a safe, a seating area and a balcony with views of the Tyrolean mountains. The atmosphere is enhanced by the elegant dining room, a separate TV room and a spacious garden restaurant. In the region's guest ratings, the establishment achieves 92.5 out of 100 points. The excellent cuisine and the personal service are particularly highlighted.

History/Background

Reliable information on the founding or the history of the house is not documented in the sources evaluated; speculation is therefore avoided. It is documented that Clara Fischbacher runs the guesthouse and cooks typically Austrian home-style dishes for her guests in the evening. The homemade braided bread is never missing from the breakfast buffet. The Kaiserwinkl region provides the setting for active holidays and relaxed days in the mountains, with the host personally offering advice. The establishment is also suitable for club and group trips and accommodates groups of up to 50 people.

Arrival

Coming from Niederndorf (motorway), turn left in the centre of Walchsee at the Pension Sonnenhof and follow the road for around 150 metres to the Pension Fischbacher. A car parking space is available. The regional tourism board lists St. Johann in Tirol (10.8 km) and Kufstein (19.6 km) as nearby railway stations. The lake is around 500 metres away, the nearest ski lift or mountain railway around 2,800 metres. The house is located directly on the cross-country ski trail. A bus parking area and bus groups are possible.

Tips

The guesthouse can also be booked with half board; a 3-course menu with Austrian home-style cooking and a fresh salad buffet every day is served. The facilities include a garden restaurant, communal lounges, sun loungers, a sun terrace, garden furniture, a drying room, a ski storage room as well as a bicycle parking space and an e-bike charging station. Included are a welcome drink, a music evening, a barbecue evening in summer and a farewell coffee. Bookings with breakfast only are also possible; for a short stay a surcharge of € 7 per person/night is charged, and for single occupancy of a double room an additional € 14 per night. Payment in cash is possible.

Best Time to Visit

The season is divided into two: summer from May to October and winter from December to April. During this time the room prices mentioned, including the breakfast buffet, are offered. Thanks to its central location, its position directly on the cross-country ski trail and its proximity to the lake of around 500 metres, the house is suitable for both summer and winter stays in the Kaiserwinkl.
